we have constructed explicit isomorphisms, in the positive characteristic case, of the quiver Hecke algebra with a diagrammatic Bott-Salmon endomorphism algebra and of the cyclotomic Hecker algebra with the corresponding endomorphism algebra, thus providing a proof of the Libedinsky- Plazas' categorical blob conjecture.

the decomposition numbers (and the associated $pK$-polynomials) of the diagrammatic Bott-Salomon endomorphism algrebras are given by the $pK$ polynomials, provided the characteristic of the field is greater than the coxeter number.
